image_prompts.prompt: The character-consistent Velociraptor from the config library in a state of exhaustion, slumped on the ground near the finish line. SUBJECT ANCHOR: Dark slate-grey pebbled skin, charcoal-grey vertical camouflage stripes, crimson feather crest/mohawk, yellow slit-pupil eyes. ANATOMY ENFORCEMENT: Each hand has exactly THREE long fingers with sharp black talons; prominent sickle claw on feet. ACTION: He is sitting in a 'Strategic Slump' on the dirt track, leaning his back against the wooden base of the Victory Stand. One leg is stretched out limply, the other is bent at the knee. His head is tilted back against the wood, eyes half-closed in weary defeat. HANDS: His three-fingered hands are resting palms-up on the dirt beside him, completely relaxed and devoid of their usual tension. FACIAL EXPRESSION: A look of intense fatigue and quiet 'dismay' that he didn't make it onto the podium. His beak is slightly open, breathing heavily. SETTING: The finish line area; the '3rd' place step of the wooden victory stand is right next to him, casting a long shadow over his body. Lush jungle and a distant volcano in the background. ART STYLE: 'STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3'. LIGHTING: 'SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC' with the warm glow of late afternoon. FRAMING: 'SQUARE_HERO_CARD' medium-full shot from a slight side-angle.
